verdicts.verify_by: cp tests/b2-rollout-gateway-switch_test.go gno.land/cmd/gnoweb/b2_rollout_gateway_switch_test.go && go test ./gno.land/cmd/gnoweb -run TestRolloutGatewaySwitch -count=1 -v: after switching the gateway to https://gw.example, expect the stored filebase src to be rewritten or filebase to stay in img-src; observe neither
verdicts.tldr: When gno.land switches -ipfs-gateway, every image stored as https://ipfs.filebase.io/ipfs/<cid> breaks: the URL is not rewritten and filebase drops out of img-src.
verdicts.details: DefaultIPFSGateway is https://ipfs.filebase.io (ipfs.go:17), and gnoweb itself shows that URL as the label of a rewritten autolink, so authors copy it into realm state. ipfsRetiredGateways (ext_ipfs.go:18-26) has no filebase entry, and SecureHeadersMiddleware adds only the configured gateway to img-src (main.go:470-471). The ADR says gno.land needs a dedicated gateway and that moving to one 'is a config change'. That change blocks every stored filebase image, which is the ipfs.io breakage this PR fixes, and no flag can bring filebase back. Recovery needs a gnoweb code change. Fix: rewrite DefaultIPFSGateway's host like a retired gateway whenever the configured gateway differs from it, by adding ipfs.filebase.io to ipfsRetiredGateways (rewriting a URL that is already on the configured gateway does nothing), and add a test that switches the gateway.
verdicts.evidence: Head, scratch worktree at fe1c9f046: go test ./gno.land/cmd/gnoweb -run TestRolloutGatewaySwitch -count=1 -v: 'step 1: autolink rendered with label "https://ipfs.filebase.io/ipfs/bafy..."'; 'step 2: default gateway: stored image allowed (https://ipfs.filebase.io in img-src)'; 'step 3: gateway https://gw.example: stored src rewritten=false, filebase in img-src=false; img-src ... https://*.githubusercontent.com https://gw.example'; --- FAIL. Base 90cebca0d: no gateway setting and no gnoweb/ipfs.go, CSP hardcodes https://ipfs.io and https://cloudflare-ipfs.com (main.go:42-43), so the switch does not exist there.

verdicts.verify_by: go test ./gno.land/cmd/gnoweb -run TestB2SubdomainGatewayRedirectCSP -v -count=1 with tests/b2-lines-subdomain-redirect-csp_test.go copied in (chromium on PATH): the no-strict control sees the <cid>.ipfs.localhost request, the strict case does not and chromium logs the img-src violation. Kubo premise: gh api repos/ipfs/kubo/contents/docs/config.md, 'Implicit defaults of Gateway.PublicGateways' (localhost UseSubdomains true) and UseSubdomains 'requests for content paths such as http://{hostname}/ipfs/{cid} produce redirect to http://{cid}.ipfs.{hostname}'
verdicts.tldr: With a subdomain gateway, such as stock Kubo on http://localhost:8080, strict gnoweb's CSP blocks every rewritten IPFS image and gnoweb logs nothing.
verdicts.details: SecureHeadersMiddleware puts only the bare origin in img-src (main.go:470-471: imgSrc.WriteString(" " + ipfsGateway)). A subdomain gateway answers /ipfs/<cid> with a redirect to <cid>.ipfs.<host>. CSP checks that redirect target, and a host-source of http://localhost:8080 does not match it. Kubo enables this redirect by default for localhost (UseSubdomains true), and normalizeIPFSGateway accepts http://localhost:8080. A self-hosted subdomain gateway, the setup the ADR names for production, fails the same way. Fix: also allow <scheme>://*.<host>[:port] in img-src for the configured gateway, or reject or warn on a gateway that redirects, and add a CSP test with a redirecting gateway.

"bafy....ipfs.localhost:40189/"]'; strict FAIL, 'gateway saw: ["localhost:39239/ipfs/bafy..."]', chromium: 'Loading the image 'http://bafy....ipfs.localhost:39239/' violates the following Content Security Policy directive: "img-src 'self' data: ...'. Kubo docs/config.md (gh api): Implicit defaults '"localhost": {"Paths": ["/ipfs", "/ipns"], "UseSubdomains": true}', and line 1597 'requests for content paths such as `http://{hostname}/ipfs/{cid}` produce redirect to `http://{cid}.ipfs.{hostname}`'. Base 90cebca0d: no configurable gateway and no rewrite, so the path cannot be reached there.
